hints.title: Pair Concatenation
hints.text: For each adjacent pair (nums[2i], nums[2i+1]), merge the numbers by concatenating their decimal digit representations.

hints.title: Integer Parsing
hints.text: Convert the concatenated string into an integer value for each adjacent pair.

hints.title: Minimum Value Track
hints.text: Maintain the running minimum across all n // 2 merged integer values.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minMergedInteger(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    ans = float('inf')
    for i in range(0, len(nums), 2):
        merged = int(f"{nums[i]}{nums[i + 1]}")
        ans = min(ans, merged)
    return ans
```

complexity.notes: Single linear pass over even length input array.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all non-adjacent pairings is invalid as pairs are fixed at (nums[2i], nums[2i+1]).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Understands pair step increment and string concatenation integer parsing.
